scope: Local QA transport; no video or production streaming algorithm changes

initialAttempts.error: Node fetch terminated during the Week 7 full movie download
initialAttempts.observed: Local preview reloaded during the request

resolution: The local-only verifier uses independent HTTP connections instead of reusing keep-alive sockets. Every original hash, byte, content-type, HTTP status and range assertion remains enforced. Production verifier requests retain their previous connection policy.
rootCause: Local preview connection reuse/reload interaction is an inference, not a proven runtime defect
finalResult: All 21 repeated page requests, five full movie hashes, 15 HTTP 206 ranges, five invalid-range 416 responses, and six browser play/seek/resume checks pass
